frequency_question: How often do executives follow through on threatened major unilateral trade restrictions within their announced timeframe when they hold direct authority?
membership_rule: Includes formal, public declarations of specific tariff rates or trade barriers directed at specific partner nations by executive action; excludes vague rhetoric not tied to specific actions or matters delegated entirely to multi-year legislative processes.

cases.name: Section 232 Tariffs on Brazilian and Argentine Steel (2019)
Restoration of Section 232 Tariffs on Canadian Aluminum (2020)

coverage_note: 5 major instances identified from the 2017-2021 period involving unilateral tariff threats and implementations.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively cover every minor historical safeguard action across all 20th-century presidencies, but captures modern direct executive tariff declarations.
validity_reason: Valid for the duration of the current presidential term, as executive trade enforcement style and centralized authority patterns remain consistent.
